component.name: Void Watcher
component.summary: Panel clock and calendar with a per-day to-do list and reminders

description.p: Void Watcher is a COSMIC panel clock that does more than tell the time. Right-click any day in the calendar to add to-do items to that date, and Void Watcher will remind you before they're due. Your list survives restarts and reboots.

Make it your default calendar and meeting invites land in it: open the .ics attached to an invite from Outlook, Google Calendar, Zoom or Teams and the meeting shows on its day with its time and repeat rule. Open the update when a meeting moves and the item moves with it; open a cancellation and it's gone.

The clock reads the same settings the stock COSMIC clock does, so whatever you pick in Settings › Date & Time — 24-hour time, seconds, weekday, date in the panel, first day of the week, even a custom format — Void Watcher follows it. Nothing to configure twice.

ul.li: Per-day to-do list — right-click a day to add items, check them off, or delete them
Recurring to-dos — daily, weekly, or yearly, with an optional end date, each occurrence checked off on its own
Opens calendar invites (.ics) — pick Void Watcher as your default calendar app; updates move the item, cancellations remove it
Desktop notifications before an item is due, with a lead time you set
To-dos persist across restarts and reboots
Panel clock that follows your Date & Time settings
Month calendar popup with previous/next navigation and a jump back to today
Works on horizontal and vertical panels

description.p: Void Watcher reads your Date & Time preferences at startup, matching how the stock COSMIC clock works. After changing a setting, restart the panel for it to take effect.
Void Watcher can be your default calendar app. Open a meeting invite (.ics) with it and the meeting lands on its day with its time and repeat rule.
Invites keep their identity: an updated invite moves the existing item instead of adding a twin, and a cancelled invite removes it. Items from invites show a small envelope.
End dates for recurring to-dos, set with a new Ends pill beside the repeat pill.
Recurrence from invites: every-Nth intervals, monthly rules, and skipped occurrences.
Recurring to-dos: daily, weekly, or yearly items, checked off per day.
Month and year label under the clock when browsing other months.
Popup layout no longer clips at Standard or Spacious interface density.
